name: Mist Walker

source.note: Entered from published reviews and guides to Ravenloft: The Horrors Within (and Van Richten's Guide to Ravenloft, which it revises); compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: Ravenloft Dark Gift. The Mists carry you between the Domains of Dread and pull you 15 feet clear of harm; they won't let you sit still.

benefits.name: Children of the Mists
benefits.summary: You can find your way through the Mists between Domains of Dread you know.
benefits.text: While in the Mists, you can find the way to any Domain of Dread you have visited before.

benefits.name: Mist Step
benefits.summary: Reaction when you take damage or fail a save against Grappled or Restrained: teleport 15 feet (PB times per Long Rest).
benefits.text: When you take damage, or fail a saving throw against the Grappled or Restrained condition, you can take a Reaction to dissolve into mist and teleport up to 15 feet to an unoccupied space you can see (escaping a grapple or restraint if you were in one). You can do this a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, regaining all uses on a Long Rest.

drawback.name: Drawback
drawback.summary: After a Long Rest you must travel at least 10 miles before a Short Rest, or make a Constitution save (DC 13 + PB) and gain nothing from it on a failure.
drawback.text: The Mists keep you moving. After each Long Rest, unless you have travelled at least 10 miles since, a Short Rest requires a Constitution saving throw (DC 13 plus your Proficiency Bonus); on a failure you gain no benefit from that Short Rest.
